title: fix(embedder-openai): batch embed() input at the provider's per-request cap
body:
Fixes #36995

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:部署方接入有单次条数上限的向量服务(通义、智谱、硅基流动等)后,知识库重建不再因为一次塞进太多文本而整批失败;界面无变化。
- 为什么做:属于「知识检索平台化」专题,替接入国内向量服务的部署方解决重建失败。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是重建请求次数变多、变慢;某一批失败时整次调用失败并指出是第几批,改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`OpenAIEmbedder.embed()` (`packages/plugins/embedder-openai/src/index.ts`) sent every input in one `POST /embeddings` request (`{ model, input: texts }`, one `resilientFetch`; premise re-read on origin/main a73edb3c). It now:

- splits `texts` into batches of at most `maxBatchSize` inputs, sends them **one after another**, and returns the vectors **in input order**;
- takes `maxBatchSize` from a new known-model cap table (`KNOWN_MAX_BATCH_SIZE`, beside `KNOWN_DIMENSIONS`; documented caps only, each with its source in the doc comment), from the new optional `OpenAIEmbedderOptions.maxBatchSize` (validated as a positive integer at construction; anything else throws), or, for any other model, a conservative default of **10** (the smallest documented cap in the table) with **one `console.warn` per embedder instance**, printed at construction. The class has no logger and none is reachable from it, so `console.warn` is used; that has precedent in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`;
- fails the whole call on a failing batch and sends no later batch. The error keeps the provider's status and response text exactly as before and appends `[batch index N of M (0-based), inputs A..B]`. The vector-count mismatch error and a transport failure (after `resilientFetch`'s own retries) carry the same suffix.

No change to `IEmbedder` or to `packages/spec/**`. Nothing else is added to what is sent: each request body has the same keys as before (`model`, `input`, optional `dimensions`).

### Provider caps: documented, not measured live

Card step 1 asks for one live over-cap request per provider. **This container holds no provider API keys, so no provider was called live.** Every cap below is **documented, not measured live**, and its source is cited. The seat decides whether a live measurement is still owed.

| Provider | Model(s) in the table | Cap used | Source (read 2026-11-24) |
|---|---|---|---|
| OpenAI | `text-embedding-3-small`, `-3-large`, `ada-002` | 2048 | developers.openai.com API reference, embeddings create: array `maxItems: 2048` ("any array must be 2048 dimensions or less"); also "a maximum of 300,000 tokens summed across all inputs in a single request" |
| 阿里通义 DashScope | `text-embedding-v3` | 10 | help.aliyun.com `model-studio/text-embedding-synchronous-api`: "最多支持 10 条(行),每条(行)最长支持 8,192 Token" |
| 阿里通义 DashScope | `text-embedding-v1`, `-v2` | 25 | same page: "最多支持 25 条(行),每条(行)最长支持 2,048 Token" |
| 智谱 BigModel | `embedding-3` | 64 | docs.bigmodel.cn API reference 文本嵌入 and the embedding-3 model page: "数组最大不得超过 64 条" |
| 硅基流动 SiliconFlow | `BAAI/bge-m3`, `BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5`, `BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5` | 32 | docs.siliconflow.com create-embeddings: array `maxItems: 32` ("Current, the maximum array size is 32") |

Models in `KNOWN_DIMENSIONS` with **no documented item cap** are left out of the cap table on purpose. They take the default of 10 and the one warning:

- 智谱 `embedding-2`: the docs state a total length ("数组总长度不得超过 8K"), not an item count.
- 火山 Doubao `doubao-embedding-*`: docs.volcengine.com 82379/1302003 gives no hard item cap, only a performance suggestion ("文本条数不超过4").
- MiniMax `embo-01`: no official cap found; the only figure (4096) is a third-party client's setting.
- Ollama `bge-m3` and `nomic-embed-text`: no cap documented.
- `BAAI/bge-base-zh-v1.5` and `BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5`: not on SiliconFlow's documented model list.

## Tests

New top-level `describe('OpenAIEmbedder batching (per-request input cap)')` in the existing harness file `src/__tests__/openai-embedder.test.ts`. It covers:

- 25 inputs on a cap-10 model are sent as `[10, 10, 5]`, and the vectors come back in input order;
- exactly the cap is one request;
- cap + 1 is two requests;
- a failing second batch rejects with the provider text and `batch index 1 of 3 (0-based), inputs 10..19`, and fetch was called exactly twice (no third request);
- a `maxBatchSize: 3` override beats the known-model cap (`[3, 3, 1]`);
- `0`, `-1`, `1.5` and `NaN` are refused;
- an unknown model is batched at 10 and warns exactly once across two `embed()` calls, while a known model, or an unknown model with an override, stays silent.

## Acceptance notes

- **The token total per request is not batched on.** OpenAI also caps a request at 300,000 tokens summed across its inputs. Batching by item count does not bound that, so 2048 long inputs can still exceed it. This is read from the docs only, not reproduced. It belongs with the input-size work the card leaves to the epic (over-long inputs and chunking). Noted, not filed.
- **Azure OpenAI deployments** are named by deployment, not by model, so they always take the default of 10 and the warning. An Azure user sets `maxBatchSize: 2048` to restore one request per 2048 inputs.
- **MiniMax request shape, unverified.** The only description of MiniMax's own embeddings endpoint I found is a third-party snippet, which shows a `texts` + `type` body rather than `input`. If that holds, the `minimax` preset may not work at all. Not reproduced, no key. Noted, not filed.
- **Error text.** Every embedder error now ends with the `[batch index …]` suffix. The leading part (`OpenAIEmbedder (BASE) → STATUS STATUSTEXT: TEXT`) is unchanged.

## Verification

2. `packages/plugins/embedder-openai/src/index.ts`: the constructor's `maxBatchSize` resolution (override, then table, then default and warning).
3. `.changeset/36995-embedder-openai-batches.md`

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/embedder-openai exec vitest run src/__tests__/openai-embedder.test.ts`. Expect `Tests 21 passed (21)`, including the seven `OpenAIEmbedder batching (per-request input cap)` cases.
